name: Kitsuki Riho
source: Gentle, easy to get along with others and an attentive girl. She speaks with the "desu wa" or "desu no" and other typical ojou-sama speech patterns. She is a bit off her knockers sometimes, relaxed and happily invades other people's personal areas. She feels there is no concept between men and women, so she is constantly hugging [url=/c14224]Soutarou[/url]. She has a clumsy side and sometimes falls down in plain areas, but during work she is more focused than anyone else, after work she will look for other things to do. She came to the island to experience what the society is like as she is from a wealthy family.
